scope_note: Selected ADR review only; no full-clause or whole-ADR certification.

decisions.review: Retain the permissive-reader decision, but make its claim boundary explicit. §9.6.4 Table 110 requires a Type 3 Encoding dictionary, so direct-name test fixtures are producer-invalid. §9.6.4 step a and §9.6.5.1 still explain what a generic named encoding means, but do not override Table 110's required Type 3 dictionary form. The tests pin compatibility behavior for documents already encountered, not normative reader acceptance.
decisions.disposition: Scratch patch labels all direct-name cases as tolerance or report-policy tests. No forced rejection change proposed.

decisions.review: The public selection geometry tests treat Type 3 text in text space; FontBBox's glyph-space role should not be conflated with normal rendering clip bounds. Table 110's outside-box behavior is explicitly implementation-dependent.
decisions.disposition: Old test fixtures are corrected to state sufficient FontBBox and d1 extents; no clipping behavior is introduced.

decisions.review: The reviewed clauses impose no dedicated result-cache requirement. Current glyph stream execution reuses the document decoded-stream cache, while the generic cache test measures decode hits/charges. No new normative or correctness gap found.
decisions.disposition: Retain as implementation/performance rationale, not conformance claims.

decisions.review: EC3 #111 changes glyph descriptions to objects and adds NOTE 2's operator-category permission subject to clause restrictions; #128 changes Type 3 resource lookup. Neither alters this shard's Encoding requirement or outside-bounds policy.
decisions.disposition: No proposed ADR amendment; source references are retained as context only.
